target: Same14-bin observed lexical POS composition of the next operational unit in the frozen source view, including EOF-ended/censored targets; no claim of complete natural sentence or true stopping
input_contract: Same68localchannels/272encoding and frozen transform; same whitespace-closed visible prefixes, original source indices and failure barriers; no future denominator, total length, endpoint flag, author or source ID as model input
weights_and_transforms: Read and hash-check the exact15checkpoint state_dicts, one frozen train transform and one frozen prior; no fit, recalibration, new normalization, parameter selection or checkpoint selection

test_time_order_diagnostic.models: same ordinaryGRU checkpoints, one per existing seed
test_time_order_diagnostic.operation: shuffle only the already visible prefix rows

primary_score: Mean valid-targetCE within each source record, then equal mean over records with >=1valid target; zero-valid records remain coverage-only
primary_comparison: Per-record DeepSets minusGRU loss, averaged across the3frozen seeds; positive means lowerGRU loss
seed_average_definition: Arithmetic mean of losses from separately scored checkpoints. This is NOT cross-entropy of averaged probabilities; no probability ensemble is evaluated.
shared_ledger: Every comparator and perturbation sees the same accepted target IDs; a model failure stops evaluation rather than producing a model-specific scoring subset

component_bootstrap.statistic: resample clusters with replacement, retain all eligible member-record paired losses, recompute record-equal mean
component_bootstrap.fewer_than_two_groups: undefined interval; retain point and coverage

speaker_sensitivity.group: declared top-level speaker key, NOT verified original author

uncertainty_scope: Descriptive resampling conditional on these fixed fitted models and supported records; does not identify latent-language truth or account for parser error, training-set/seed-selection uncertainty, unknown copying or all source dependence
post_prediction_diagnostics: First persist/hash ALL17main+3perturbation prediction series. Only then compute source-terminal/interior and ordinary-character-extensibility strata; endpoint labels do not affect predictions, primary score or model choices.
stop_on: test partition has zero scoreable records
future_10x_data_expansion: Separate next experiment; do not retrofit this fixed train/development/test frame or retrain its checkpoints

extraction_dependency_binding.training_receipt_module_hashes: Verify every previously extracted linguistic/segmentation/observed-producer dependency before test unseal and again before final report
extraction_dependency_binding.pre_unseal_implementation_hardening: Added during independent code review; no statistical rule, sample, model or target changed
